email.description: Email address for Let's Encrypt account registration (used for expiry and recovery). Optional but recommended.

target.description: ACME server URL. Use the staging URL for testing to avoid rate limits.

renew_threshold.description: Minimum remaining validity (in seconds) required before triggering renewal. Default: 30 days.

timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for external operations (e.g., HTTP/DNS challenge verification).

dns_retry_limit.description: Maximum number of attempts to verify DNS record propagation before giving up.

use_http_challenge.description: Enable HTTP-01 challenge (requires public HTTP access to /.well-known/acme-challenge/).

use_dns_challenge.description: Enable DNS-01 challenge (required for wildcard certificates or when HTTP is unavailable).

use_tls_alpn_challenge.description: Enable TLS-ALPN-01 challenge (requires service to support ALPN on port 443).

private_key_type.description: Type of private key to generate for new certificates: rsa, ec256, or ec384.

private_key_size.description: RSA key size (ignored if privateKeyType is ec256/ec384).

dns_provider.description: DNS provider configuration (required only if useDNSChallenge is true).

certs.description: List of certificate groups. Each group requests a single certificate covering the listed domains.

name.description: Human-readable name for the certificate group (for documentation).

domains.description: List of domain names to include in this certificate (CN + SANs). Must include at least one FQDN.
